inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject if volume and margin deteriorate, cash flow depends on underinvestment or working-capital timing, lease-adjusted leverage rises, or distributions cease to be covered.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: Recurring grocery demand, online growth and disciplined payout can transmit operating resilience into per-share cash returns if margins, leases and leverage remain controlled.

objective: Review whether Ahold Delhaize has a material causal relationship to defensive consumer cash-return resilience.
